S88.03.note: The extension only opens the web support page (/support). The form, the describing of a problem and the follow-up replies are on the web side and were not checked here.
steps: Sign in, then click the "More" button in the side panel header (its label is "More").
Click "Help" in the menu. The options page opens on its Help section.
In the Help section, find the row "Contact support" with the hint "Reach a person about your account."
Click "Open" beside it, and look at the new tab that opens to the support page, then compare with Expected.

S88.07.note: The app does not preview the bundle in the page, and sending it to support is a manual attachment, not a button. If not signed in, the status reads "Sign in first, the bundle is redacted on the server."
steps: Sign in, then click the "More" button in the side panel header.
Click "Help". The options page opens on its Help section.
Find the row "Export diagnostics" with the hint "Saves a redacted bundle to attach to a support request. The server redacts it before you get the file." Read the hint.

Click "Export" beside it. A JSON file downloads and the status line under the row shows a summary. Compare with Expected: the file is the only view of the contents, so open it in a text editor to see what it holds, then decide whether to attach it to a support request.

Make a request fail (for example, a server error or a quota block); the failed reply is shown in the chat.
